statement: You have a rod of length n, where n is the length of the array prices. A piece of length L sells for prices[L − 1].
You may cut the rod into pieces of whole-number lengths, as many cuts as you like or none at all, and sell every piece.
Return the most money you can get for the whole rod.

examples.explanation: The rod has length 5. Cutting it into lengths 2 and 3 gives 5 + 7 = 12; selling it whole gives only 10.
The rod has length 4. Four pieces of length 1 give 4 × 3 = 12, better than any other cut.
